::: {#hero}
I am an ecosystem ecologist interested in the biotic and environmental factors that control the structure and functioning of ecosystems, especially aquatic and freshwater ones. I work at the reach and catchment scale, combining field campaigns with manipulative experiments to evaluate how streams respond to environmental change.

I work on carbon and nutrient cycling and on the role of organisms in driving these processes, with a particular interest in karst aquatic ecosystems --- where calcium carbonate precipitates --- and in how organisms affect, and are affected by, these systems.
:::
